title: pytest-bdd skill (agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd)
item: pytest-bdd skill: turn a new-format agent spec into BDD tests that gate a built agent, built on the cafe example first
motivation: A built agent needs a gate that checks it against the spec's rules; writing those tests spec by spec without a skill does not scale; and the work feeds findings back into agent-spec
notes: Plan: tasks/plans/001.md, rewritten 2026-11-16 after an independent review. Only slice A is up for approval: task 49. Slices B to E are an outline (B all of the cafe; C broken variants by a different builder; D write the skill; E blind run on a Harbor Goods spec) and are planned again from A's results. This task stays open as the parent and closes when the last slice passes. Riskiest assumption, agreed with the owner 2026-11-16: tests proven on a scripted agent give right verdicts on a real LLM agent. Values the spec does not hold live in one labelled data file in the test folder; agent-spec is not changed. Superseded: the earlier build order (fake order system, grader primitives, S01, S12, S20, S26, S41) was for the old spec format and the order-cancel example.
source_chat: Pytest-bdd verification for agent-spec (Nov 1); Order-support agent login design (Nov 5–6)
done_means: Draft, to be fixed when slices B to E are planned. The agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd skill turns a new-format spec into feature files, written by a script with every word copied from the spec, a labelled data file, and a test harness. On the cafe example the reference agent passes every test, and each broken variant, written by a builder that did not see the rule checkers, fails the Then sentence of the rule it breaks. A drift check stops the test run when a scenario changes in the spec. Slice A's five pass/fail lines held (task 49). A fresh session using only the skill produces the same for a Harbor Goods new-format spec.
draft_note: Rewritten by Claude in chat on 2026-11-16 at the owner's request, from the plan in tasks/plans/001.md. done_means and verified_by are drafts until the owner approves the plan. Owner decided 2026-11-15: build on the cafe new-format spec first. Branch add-agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd holds earlier work for the old format, not reviewed and not built on.
